source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.3 (PDF 132, printed 129).

blocks.text: Koi bhi research ya analysis karne ke liye data collection (data jama karna) aur preparation (data ko tayyar karna) bohat zaroori steps hain. Data ki quality (kitna achha aur sahi hai) aur relevance (kaam se kitna juda hua hai) seedha results par asar dalti hain. Is hisse mein data jama karne ke tareeqe aur use analysis ke liye tayyar karna bataya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Kharab data kharab results kyun deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Koi bhi analysis ya model utna hi sahi hota hai jitna us ka data; data ki ghaltiyan, khali jagahein ya irrelevant (kaam se na judi) information seedhi results mein chali jati hain.

items: Achhe results ke liye achha data: dhyan se jama karein aur analysis se pehle tayyar karein.
